استمددت (form X)
# اِسْتَمْدَدْتُ (istamdadtu) /is.tam.dad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# اِسْتَمْدَدْتَ (istamdadta) /is.tam.dad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# اِسْتَمْدَدْتِ (istamdadti) /is.tam.dad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# اُسْتُمْدِدْتُ (ustumdidtu) /us.tum.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
